title: Crystal
description: A Crystal is a single admitted memory or skill record in the CRYSTALIUM lattice. Every write/promote funnels through the enforcement chokepoint before any store mutation runs.

id.description: Globally unique crystal identifier (UUID v4 or v7).

layer.description: Memory layer this crystal belongs to.

content_ref.description: SHA-256 blob-tier address of the full content payload. REQUIRED when layer=episodic. Index→pointer→content pattern (MISSION.md §Index→pointer→content).

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the crystal content. Stored in SQLite FTS5 for BM25 recall.

embedding_ref.description: Reference to the vector embedding in LanceDB (crystal_id key).

provenance.description: Who wrote this crystal, when, and from what source.

source.description: Trust-tier classification of the originating source.

author_agent.description: Eidolon or agent identifier that wrote this crystal.

task_id.description: Task or session identifier under which this crystal was created.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the crystal was created.

trust_tier.description: Trust tier at admission time. Carries through cross-agent reads and summarization (MISSION.md §Trust tier carries through). Takes MIN of all input tiers on consolidation.

validation_state.description: Current admission state of this crystal.

scope.description: Scope triple controlling access, isolation, and redaction (MISSION.md §Scope+redaction).

project.description: Project identifier scoping this crystal. v1.6: canonical (data-dir-derived) key on write paths.

project_raw.description: v1.6: caller-supplied project label, preserved verbatim when it differed from the canonical key and was normalized into `project`. Absent when no normalization occurred.

agent_class_visibility.description: Which agent classes can read this crystal. null = all.

temporal.description: Bi-temporal validity window (MISSION.md §Updates are bi-temporal). Never hard-delete.

t_valid_from.description: RFC 3339 timestamp from which this crystal is valid.

t_valid_to.description: RFC 3339 timestamp until which this crystal was valid. null = currently valid.

superseded_by.description: ID of the crystal that supersedes this one. null = not superseded.

utility.description: Utility signals used by the importance function (FORGE D6) and Dream eviction.

access_count.description: Total number of times this crystal has been recalled.

last_access.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of most recent recall.

outcome_success_score.description: Normalised outcome success score [0, 1]. null = unscored.

importance.description: Cached importance score [0, 1] from importance_score() (FORGE D6). Recomputed by Dream.

novelty_at_write.description: Novelty score [0, 1] at the time of writing. Frozen at write time per FORGE D6 (recomputation is OQ-9).

memory_dynamics.description: Memory-dynamics signals consumed by later-wave algorithms. UNPOPULATED in v0.2.0 (schema-first migration); no code reads or writes these yet. Bounds are intentionally left open to avoid a breaking bump when waves W2/W4 fix their ranges.

stability.description: FSRS memory stability (W4 forgetting faculty). null = uncomputed.

retrievability.description: FSRS retrievability at last access (W4). null = uncomputed.

evb.description: Expected Value of Backup importance signal (W2). null = uncomputed.

prediction_error.description: Encoding-time prediction error / surprise signal (W2/W3). null = uncomputed.

tags.description: Free-form retrieval tags. UNPOPULATED in v0.2.0; defaults to empty.

protected.description: When true, the crystal is exempt from Dream eviction/forgetting (W4). UNPOPULATED in v0.2.0; defaults to false.

encoding_context.description: Context captured at encoding time for context-dependent recall (W5). UNPOPULATED in v0.2.0; shape intentionally open for later waves. null = none.
